lines.text: Many learners say: I am proud with my son.
Better: I am proud of my son.
Of! I am proud of my team.

data.wrong: I am proud with my son.
data.right: I am proud of my son.
data.memory: I am proud of my son.

native.tip: Kita bilang “bangga dengan anakku”. Di bahasa Inggris, setelah proud pakai of, bukan with.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I am proud with my son.” 😅 Setelah proud, pakai of: “I am proud of my son.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “of”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I am proud of my son.” lalu tulis satu orang yang kamu banggakan. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “bangga dengan anakku”. In English, after proud use of, not with.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I am proud with my son.” 😅 After proud, use of: “I am proud of my son.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
